GBFRER Summon Drop Picker (GUI) - Changelog
===========================================

v2.1.0
------
- Added Albacore III and Furycane Nihilla as selectable summons
- Astral summons can now be capped to 50% (normal-tier) instead of 100%
- Fixed leaked rolls: caps, bonuses and skill levels no longer drift off your pick
- Fixed Furycane skills not rolling at max level
- Recommended farm quest shown next to each summon, colored by difficulty
- Restore vanilla tables button for a clean uninstall

v2.0.0
------
- Major rewrite: fully independent, per-summon customization
- Wee Pincer III added as a selectable summon
- Full 11-bonus menu for every summon
- Every summon offers its full skill pool
- Skills locked to max level 15
- New picker engine
- Picks are saved

Source code: https://github.com/Evoyn/gbfer-summon-drop-picker
Mod page: https://www.nexusmods.com/granbluefantasyrelink/mods/677
